response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS cnt FROM constructors c LEFT JOIN constructorStandings cs ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality) SELECT constructorId, nationality, cnt AS record_count, cnt - (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) FROM counts) AS diff_from_avg FROM counts ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
